title: Google Local Pack Results API input

queries.title: Google search queries
queries.description: Local-intent searches to snapshot, such as ['dentist near me', 'emergency dentist']. Each query runs at every supplied location. Provide 1–100 non-empty queries; this Actor does not generate keywords.

locations.title: Search locations
locations.description: Each location must specify exactly one of locationCode, locationName, or locationCoordinate. Coordinates are best for a precise neighborhood snapshot and must be latitude,longitude,radius in metres. Maximum 25 locations and 500 total query/location snapshots per run.

label.title: Location label
label.description: Human-readable name for the snapshot, e.g. Downtown New York.

locationCode.title: DataForSEO location code
locationCode.description: DataForSEO Google location code, e.g. 2840 for the United States. Do not combine with locationName or locationCoordinate.

locationName.title: DataForSEO location name
locationName.description: Full DataForSEO location name, e.g. New York,New York,United States. Do not combine with another location selector.

locationCoordinate.title: GPS coordinate and radius
locationCoordinate.description: latitude,longitude,radius in metres, e.g. 40.7128,-74.0060,500. The radius must be 199–199999 metres.

languageCode.title: Search language
languageCode.description: the keyword-data API Google language code, e.g. en or es. Defaults to en; it controls the SERP language, not the location.

device.title: Device
device.description: Google result layout to request. Local-pack appearance can vary by device.

seDomain.title: Google domain
seDomain.description: Optional Google domain such as google.com, google.co.uk, or google.de. Leave blank to let the keyword-data API choose a domain for the selected language and location.

maxLocalPackResults.title: Maximum local-pack businesses per snapshot
maxLocalPackResults.description: Maximum local-pack businesses to return from each Google SERP block. Defaults to 3 to match the common local 3-pack; use up to 20 only when the provider returns more businesses in the local-pack block.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
